parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
One of a group of three students is to be chosen at random.

Explain how a single throw of a fair six-sided dice could be used to make the choice.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: The times, in minutes, taken by students to complete a test are normally distributed with mean 125 and variance 50. Two students are chosen at random.
parts.text: Find the probability that the difference between the times taken by these two students to complete the test is more than 12 minutes.
